scripts.db:migrate:local: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply midnight-sensor-data-v2 --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply midnight-sensor-data-v2 --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.config:network: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put PUBLIC_MIDNIGHT_NETWORK --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.config:contract: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler secret put PUBLIC_SENSOR_REGISTRY_CONTRACT_ADDRESS --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.destroy: node ../../scripts/require-development-host.mjs && wrangler delete --config wrangler.jsonc --name midnight-proof-gateway && wrangler d1 delete midnight-sensor-data-v2 --config wrangler.jsonc --skip-confirmation
